Assistant: This should probably affect #2256. I’m checking whether we should promote #2408 from p2 decision to an active p1 design/development slice or split it into immediate implementation issues.

Assistant: The director is still running, so I’m not going to idle. I’ll inspect the linked generated-builder gap and then make the minimal queue adjustment if the evidence is strong enough.

Assistant: I’m going to make the first queue adjustment now: promote #2408 into the active clean-break/DX queue and record it as a blocker for #2256. That is not a code decision yet; it just prevents the onboarding proof from passing while custom app kinds still require raw hand-rolling.

Assistant: I’m updating #2256 in place rather than creating a parallel plan: #2408 needs to be part of the DX gate’s blocker list. The clean-room proof should include “define one app-private kind with generated builders,” otherwise it proves the wrong thing.
